title: Social Reference Points and Risk Taking
eligible_reason: Laboratory experiment with six between-subjects treatments (HI/LO social reference point x main/peer-lottery/nonsocial). analysis.do runs cross-sectional OLS of risk taking on treatment indicators and treatment-by-treatment interactions (reg upside hi i.hi##i.non i.hi##i.peerlottery riskattitude_std i.wave, r); the 'difference-in-differences' is a contrast across treatment arms, not a panel with staggered adoption.
design_notes: analysis.do (Stata reg, robust SEs) on all.dta; zTree code in all_ztts.7z; instructions and screenshots PDFs.
